subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently drop a replayed assistant turn whenever removing NO_REPLY leaves only recognized thinking-family blocks, while handling the issue's orphaned-tool-result trigger separately?
rationale: The patch is a bounded recovery for a production failure, but deleting a complete persisted replay turn is a session-history policy choice and the broader Anthropic replay proposals closed without establishing a canonical replacement.

options.title: Accept narrow rule after repair
options.body: Preserve unknown blocks, add the missing regression test, and land this NO_REPLY-specific recovery while leaving the second trigger on the canonical issue.

options.title: Require one broader policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the NO_REPLY and orphaned-tool-result triggers share a maintainer-approved provider or replay-boundary solution.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow rule after repair
recommendation.body: Preserve unknown blocks, add the missing regression test, and land this NO_REPLY-specific recovery while leaving the second trigger on the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository contributor guide routes agents and subagents ownership to Tyler Yust, and this decision defines replay-history policy for that area.
